_note: The occupiers took the workers' payroll when they took the plant. Take it back off their leader and hand it to the
foreman, who is waiting outside with the people it belongs to. The verb is PAY: the money goes to the people it is
owed to, and the foreman is the last thing you meet. The talk is at the entrance, so he is never inside.
Industrial dungeons (LocTypeDungeon_ThemeIndustrial, 20 per Eliza's count), vanilla interiors that carry the
delve markers today. Every word holds in any of them: nothing names the site, the faction or what the plant
made; everything a line points at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Industrial dungeons; the delve marker set.

prose.name: Recovery: Workers' Payroll on <Planet>
prose.briefing: When the occupiers took the <Place>, they took the workers' payroll with it. The foreman is waiting outside.
prose.card: Recovery contract. The payroll for the <Place> on <Planet> was seized with the site. Recover it and return it to the site foreman, who is waiting outside. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Defeat the occupiers' leader at the <Place>
beats.journal: The occupiers' leader at the <Place> is dead. She kept the payroll close.
say: The payroll will be somewhere she could keep an eye on it.

beats.journal: The payroll case was where the leader could watch it, still sealed. Not a credit missing. The foreman is outside the <Place>.
beats.name: Payroll Case

message.title: Payroll Case
message.text: Still sealed. Somebody had tried the lock with a knife, more than once, and given up.

beats.objective: Bring the payroll to the foreman
beats.journal: The occupiers took the <Place> and the workers' payroll with it. I took the payroll back and gave it to the foreman.

person.name: Hollis Brandt
hellos: Easy. Everyone out here's owed money, and they're all a bit tense about it.

greeting: You came out the right door. Is that our payroll?
Forty people have been working on a promise for a month.

reply: All of it? You didn't take a cut?
Then I'm buying you a drink, out of my own share. Thank you.

exchanges.prompt: Why not just pay them again?
reply: With what? That case was the money.
The owners pay once. They were very clear about that.

exchanges.prompt: What will they do with it?
reply: Rent, mostly. Food. Somebody's got a wedding.
And then we go back to work, which I'm told is the point.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 ends the talk, takes the Payroll Case and sets stage 100. Voice 'Charlie', unused so far; the same voice on the radio.

broadcast: You're at the plant? I'm outside, by the way in.
They took our pay when they took the place. Get it back off whoever's in charge in there.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Not yet heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
